info.title: Fenergo Nebula Authorization Query
info.description:
**Authorization Query API**:
Authorization Command API provides methods related to the user authorization. Use the Authorization Command API to create and manage teams and user-team assignments. Use the Query API to retrieve Team aggregates, Access Layers and user profiles.
**Authorization Query API provides**:
  • The ability to query for Teams.
  • The ability to query for Access Layers.
  • The ability to query for Dynamic Access Layer Configurations.
  • The ability to query for Users (proxied to identity service).
  • The ability to query for User Profile (proxied to identity service) and User Authorization Profile.
